Fig. 2. Overview of the proposed PML-MA framework. The method comprises: (1) Label Low-Rank Orthogonal decomposition (LLRO) decomposes candidate labels Y into orthogonal basis Q and pseudo-labels R; (2) Global Modal Alignment (LGMA) projects features X and pseudo-labels R into a common subspace via P1 and P2; (3) Local Modal Alignment (LLMA) preserves neighborhood structures using similarity relationships; (4) Multi-peak Class Prototype learning (LMCP ) models the multi-peak distribution where instance xi with pseudo-labels ri = [0.7, 0.8, 0.4, 0] (yielding dii = 1.9) is guided by multiple class prototypes. The final classifier P2P⊤ 1 is derived from the aligned projection matrices.
